outline: This course introduces HyperText Markup Language (HTML) and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS). The course topics include: 1. HTML syntax, 2. CSS syntax, 3. JavaScript, 4. HTML5 APIs syntactic features, 5. CSS3 features,  6. Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG),  7. HTML5 Canvas API 8. WebGL
schedule:
Week1-3: HTML syntax,
Week4-6: CSS syntax
Week7-9: JavaScript
Week10-11: HTML5 APIs syntactic features,
Week12-13: CSS3 features,
Week14-16: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG)
Week17. HTML5 Canvas API
Week18. WebGL
assessment:
Weekly Lab Assignments 50%
Midterm Project 20%
Mini task 5%
Final Project 25%
